reviews.question:
Some people regard video games as harmless fun, or even as a useful educational tool. Others, however, believe that video games are having an adverse effect on the people who play them.
In your opinion, do the drawbacks of video games outweigh the benefits?
reviews.originalEssay:
Some people regard video games as harmless fun, or even as a useful educational tool. Others, however, believe that video games are having an adverse effect on the people who play them. In my opinion, although gaming can provide some educational and recreational benefits, its drawbacks outweigh its advantages.

On the one hand, video games can offer several benefits in terms of education and entertainment. Players are transported into a virtual world where they can experience activities that are difficult or impossible in real life, such as racing, shooting or exploring. This can provide a sense of novelty and excitement that some real-life pastimes cannot offer. Furthermore, certain games require players to constantly think about strategies and make decisions, which can help develop skills such as problem-solving, teamwork and decision-making. However, these gains seem relatively insignificant since such abilities can be properly developed through healthier alternatives, such as team sports, reading or debate clubs. These activities can provide similar benefits without exposing young people to the same risks associated with excessive gaming.

On the other hand, I believe that the disadvantages of video games are more significant, particularly because of their addictive nature. Many games give players scores, new targets and frequent rewards, which can encourage them to continue playing in order to feel a sense of achievement. For example, children may spend hours trying to complete different levels or achieve a higher score than their friends. Such addiction can lead to a range of negative consequences. Players may suffer from a lack of sleep and eye strain due to spending long periods in front of screens. In addition, gaming often involves a sedentary lifestyle, which can contribute to physical health problems. For students, excessive gaming may also interfere with their education, as homework and revision can be sacrificed for several hours of playing games.

In conclusion, while video games can be enjoyable and may help develop certain skills, these benefits can also be gained through other activities with fewer risks. Therefore, I believe that the drawbacks of video games, especially addiction and its effects on health and education, outweigh their benefits.

Topic: It is now possible for scientists and tourists to travel to remote areas with natural environments, such as the South Pole. Is this a positive or negative development?

Model Answer
In recent times, advances in transport have enabled both tourists and researchers to visit isolated natural destinations across the globe. In my opinion, this is a positive development because it provides unique personal experiences for travelers and yields essential scientific knowledge for humanity.

Firstly, granting tourists access to remote regions offers unprecedented travel experiences. No matter how many famous attractions exist around the world, passionate globetrotters continuously crave novelty. Traveling to an island unknown to the vast majority of people allows travelers to witness rare plants and animals, sample local dishes, and participate in the exotic practices of indigenous communities. Granted, one might say that people can view these things on TV channels dedicated to travel. However, the experience of watching a screen is far inferior to experiencing such activities in person.

Secondly, permitting scientists to conduct fieldwork in remote areas brings immense benefits to global research. Regardless of how much we already know about the world, there is still much that is unknown in the field of science. Visiting unexplored places gives scientists answers to many existing and future problems. For instance, studying how global warming affects the habitats of elusive animals in heavily wooded areas or deep underwater helps experts restore damaged ecosystems. Furthermore, researching how novel viruses break out in remote regions ensures societies are far more prepared for potential outbreaks that could kill millions in the future.

In conclusion, opening remote environments to visitors is a highly positive trend. It enriches the lives of travelers through first-hand experiences and empowers scientists to protect ecosystems and prevent future disease outbreaks.

reviews.question: If a product is good or meets people’s needs, they will buy it. Therefore, advertising is unnecessary and no more than entertainment. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
It is argued by some that high product quality and meeting consumer needs are the sole drivers of purchasing decisions, rendering advertising redundant and purely entertaining. While I acknowledge that product excellence is foundational to commercial success, I completely disagree with the notion that advertising is unnecessary.   
   On the one hand, there is no doubt that a product's ability to fulfil customers’ needs and maintain high quality standards is vital for its long-term success. When a product excels at meeting consumer expectations, it naturally creates positive word-of-mouth publicity, which is often far more credible than traditional advertising. Satisfied customers tend to recommend exceptional items to their friends and family, generating organic promotion. For example, many local businesses thrive purely on the basis of their superior product quality and the organic growth of their customer base, without needing to invest heavily in marketing campaigns.   
   On the other hand, the necessity of advertising cannot be completely dismissed. With an ever-increasing number of products and services on the market, advertising is essential for companies to distinguish themselves from their competitors and make potential customers aware of their offerings. Advertising plays a pivotal role in achieving this by allowing businesses to reach a wider audience and establish a memorable brand identity, thereby helping them stay ahead of their rivals. This is clearly seen in how even leading global firms unfailingly invest in advertisements across multiple platforms to maintain their market presence. Ultimately, while a product cannot go far in the market without advertising, advertising alone cannot ensure long-term success without genuine quality.   
    In conclusion, although superior quality and organic customer satisfaction are crucial, advertising serves a far greater purpose than mere entertainment. It remains an essential tool for market recognition and brand differentiation, making both high product standards and strategic advertising indispensable to business growth

reviews.question:
Today, the high sales of popular consumer goods reflect the power of advertising and not the real needs of the society in which they are sold.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
It is argued by some that the impressive sales figures of popular consumer goods demonstrate the power of advertising rather than the actual needs of society. While I accept that marketing campaigns significantly influence purchasing decisions, I disagree with the view that advertising creates artificial demands, as it merely strengthens pre-existing needs.                 
    On the one hand, advertising can tempt people into buying products that they might not otherwise need. Advertising agencies almost always employ different marketing strategies, such as eye-catching graphics, engaging content, and celebrity endorsements, to sway consumers' decisions. These tactics can create a strong desire for non-essential items. For example, the rise in sales of smartphones and tablets can be attributed to highly effective advertising campaigns of high-tech corporations like Apple or Samsung, which persuade consumers to upgrade their devices even when their existing ones function well.   
    On the other hand, believing that advertising creates a completely new need is a mistake; instead, there must be some kind of pre-existing need in society that advertising simply amplifies. Indeed, there must be some underlying requirement before a person makes a shopping decision. For instance, the sharp increase in demand for cosmetic products, particularly among females, can be ascribed to existing concerns about whether physical appearance determines success and happiness. Advertising merely amplifies these concerns by constantly highlighting the benefits of beauty-enhancing products and raising public awareness of the wide range of options available on the market. Thus, advertising does not create new needs but reinforces pre-existing ones.   
    In conclusion, although advertising plays a crucial role in driving consumer spending through persuasive strategies, it does not invent new demands from nothing. High sales figures ultimately stem from pre-existing societal needs that advertisements help to highlight and expand.
reviews.overall: Em giữ đúng toàn bộ hướng lập luận và các ví dụ của Topic 1.3: thừa nhận sức tác động của quảng cáo rồi giải thích rằng nhu cầu sẵn có mới là nền tảng của quyết định mua. Hai đoạn thân phát triển đủ chuỗi ý và dùng ví dụ đúng nguồn. Bài chỉ cần sửa cách nêu quan điểm ở mở bài để vận dụng mẫu đã học thay vì dừng ở I disagree; đây là yêu cầu bài luyện, không phải lỗi ngữ pháp.

Indeed, there must be some underlying requirement before a person makes a shopping decision. For instance, the sharp increase in demand for cosmetic products, particularly among females, can be ascribed to existing concerns about whether physical appearance determines success and happiness. Advertising merely amplifies these concerns by constantly highlighting the benefits of beauty-enhancing products and raising public awareness of the wide range of options available on the market. Thus, advertising does not create new needs but reinforces pre-existing ones.

In conclusion, although advertising plays a crucial role in driving consumer spending through persuasive strategies, it does not invent new demands from nothing. High sales figures ultimately stem from pre-existing societal needs that advertisements help to highlight and expand.

reviews.question:
Research indicates that nowadays some consumers are much less influenced by advertising than in the past.
What are the reasons for this trend?
Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
Recent studies reveal that modern consumers are becoming significantly less swayed by advertisements compared to the past. This shift is primarily driven by the oversaturation of promotional content in daily life, and I firmly believe that this is a positive development for both consumers and businesses.    
    The main reason why people pay less attention to advertising is its overwhelming presence in daily life. On social media platforms like YouTube, most viewers immediately click the "skip" button after a few seconds, while users on Facebook or TikTok often scroll past sponsored posts without paying any attention. Furthermore, a growing number of individuals install ad-blocking software to avoid being disturbed by pop-ups. As a result, many have reported that they now rely more on online reviews, star ratings, and personal recommendations than on glossy commercials when making purchasing decisions.   
    I see this trend as a positive development for two main reasons. Firstly, consumers are less likely to be manipulated by emotional or exaggerated messages from advertisers. Instead, they rely on careful comparisons, customer reviews, and their actual needs before making a purchase. Such behavior leads to a more intelligent and responsible form of consumption. Secondly, from the perspective of companies, this trend forces them to invest in product quality, customer service, and innovation rather than relying solely on marketing. In the long run, both businesses and consumers benefit from a market that rewards genuine value over aggressive promotion.   
    In conclusion, the diminishing influence of advertising is caused by ad fatigue and a shift toward more reliable information sources. This is a welcome shift as it promotes rational spending habits and encourages businesses to focus on product excellence.
reviews.overall: Cô nhận xét bài của em đạt yêu cầu. Em trả lời đủ hai câu hỏi: nêu đúng nguyên nhân người tiêu dùng ít bị quảng cáo chi phối và khẳng định đây là xu hướng tích cực. Hai đoạn thân bám sát dàn ý, có ví dụ cụ thể và nối được từ thói quen tiếp xúc quảng cáo sang việc mua hàng có cân nhắc hơn. reviews.question:
Online shopping is increasing dramatically.
How could this trend affect our environment and the kinds of jobs required?
reviews.originalEssay:
In recent years, the boom in e-commerce has fundamentally reshaped consumer habits worldwide. This dramatic increase in online shopping has a double-edged impact on the natural environment and is significantly transforming the current job market.

On the one hand, the environmental effects of online shopping present a complex mix of negative and positive consequences. From an environmental perspective, the exponential growth of online purchases has driven the advent of extensive delivery services. These logistics networks rely heavily on an unimaginably large amount of plastic wrapping, which has spawned numerous landfills filled with non-biodegradable waste. Consequently, this poses severe health risks for various species living on Earth. Conversely, this trend can also contribute positively to the environment by reducing the need for individuals to commute to physical stores. Fewer personal vehicles on the road help lower traffic volume, thereby mitigating the overuse of natural resources and reducing total greenhouse gas emissions. Thus, while packaging waste increases, there could be a notable decrease in pollution caused by transportation.

On the other hand, in terms of employment, online shopping clearly transforms the job landscape. Online platforms increasingly rely on automatic systems to handle orders, payments, and customer support, which effectively removes the need for basic retail roles such as cashiers or sales staff. As traditional roles in physical shops are replaced by technology, individuals without higher education or specialized technical skills find it increasingly harder to secure a job. However, new employment areas appear as a direct result of this transformation. The shift creates a higher demand for roles in technology, delivery, and online advertising, such as website builders, customer service representatives, and digital marketing staff. Ultimately, this leads to a job market that offers more choices, particularly in technology-driven sectors.

In conclusion, while the surge in online shopping poses environmental threats regarding packaging waste, it offers a greener alternative by cutting down vehicle emissions. Simultaneously, it shifts the employment landscape away from low-skilled traditional retail jobs toward technology and logistics-oriented professions.

In recent years, the boom in e-commerce has fundamentally reshaped consumer habits worldwide. This dramatic increase in online shopping has a double-edged impact on the natural environment and is significantly transforming the current job market.

In terms of the environment, the environmental effects of online shopping present a complex mix of negative and positive consequences. From an environmental perspective, the exponential growth of online purchases has driven the advent of extensive delivery services. These logistics networks rely heavily on an unimaginably large amount of plastic wrapping, which has spawned numerous landfills filled with non-biodegradable waste. Consequently, this poses severe health risks for various species living on Earth. Conversely, this trend can also contribute positively to the environment by reducing the need for individuals to commute to physical stores. Fewer personal vehicles on the road help lower traffic volume, thereby mitigating the overuse of natural resources and reducing total greenhouse gas emissions. Thus, while packaging waste increases, there could be a notable decrease in pollution caused by transportation.

In terms of employment, online shopping clearly transforms the job landscape. Online platforms increasingly rely on automatic systems to handle orders, payments, and customer support, which effectively removes the need for basic retail roles such as cashiers or sales staff. As traditional roles in physical shops are replaced by technology, individuals without higher education or specialized technical skills find it increasingly harder to secure a job. However, new employment areas appear as a direct result of this transformation. The shift creates a higher demand for roles in technology, delivery, and online advertising, such as website builders, customer service representatives, and digital marketing staff. Ultimately, this leads to a job market that offers more choices, particularly in technology-driven sectors.

In conclusion, while the surge in online shopping poses environmental threats regarding packaging waste, it offers a greener alternative by cutting down vehicle emissions. Simultaneously, it shifts the employment landscape away from low-skilled traditional retail jobs toward technology and logistics-oriented professions.

reviews.question:
Some say that news has no connection with most people's lives, and it is a waste of time for most of us to read newspapers and watch television news programs.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
Some people believe that news programs and newspapers have little to do with the daily lives of ordinary people, and that following the news is simply a waste of time. I completely disagree with this point of view because news directly affects us in many ways, and keeping up with current events brings important benefits.

First of all, it is wrong to say that news is disconnected from people's lives, as international and national events often have a direct impact on individuals. For example, the US presidential election may seem completely unrelated to someone living in Vietnam at first. However, who becomes the new president can lead to major changes in global trade and foreign policies. During the Trump administration, trade tensions between the US and China weakened the Chinese economy, which led to a reduction in China's aggressive actions in the Southeast Sea. As a result, many Vietnamese people followed this news closely because it directly related to their national security and daily peace.

Furthermore, reading or watching the news is not a waste of time, as it helps raise public awareness and prepares people for potential risks. News reports inform the public about critical issues such as rising crime rates, upcoming natural disasters, or government policies. Being aware of these situations helps communities stay safe and better prepared. On the other hand, constant exposure to negative or exaggerated news can sometimes cause stress or anxiety. However, as long as people choose reliable sources and consume news in moderation, the benefits of staying informed far outweigh the downsides.

In conclusion, I strongly disagree that news is irrelevant or a waste of time. Major news events continuously shape our lives, and staying informed is essential for making better decisions and protecting ourselves in modern society.
reviews.overall: Em trả lời rõ ràng cả hai vế của đề, giữ lập trường phản đối xuyên suốt và phát triển hai đoạn thân bài mạch lạc. Chuỗi ở Body 1 đã cho thấy một tin quốc tế có thể đi tới an ninh của người Việt Nam; Body 2 cũng nêu đúng tác dụng cảnh báo để cộng đồng chuẩn bị. Em cần sửa cách viết tắt United States và hoàn chỉnh hơn chi tiết ví dụ bầu cử theo chuỗi đã học, rồi tự soát lại bản sửa.

reviews.question:
Some people say we do not need printed newspaper anymore.
To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
reviews.originalEssay:
Some people argue that traditional printed newspapers are no longer necessary in today's digital world. I completely agree with this view because the benefits of online news platforms far outweigh those of printed newspapers.

On the one hand, some supporters argue that printed newspapers are still needed due to their reliability and accessibility for certain groups. Unlike many uncontrolled online platforms, printed newspapers are required to follow strict journalistic standards and undergo rigorous fact-checking procedures, which allows readers to trust the information. In addition, physical newspapers remain essential for older people or those who lack technological skills and Internet access. However, this argument is becoming less convincing over time. Today, many reputable online news platforms also have strict editorial standards, showing that accuracy depends on the publisher rather than the paper format. Furthermore, digital literacy is improving rapidly, and smart devices with affordable Internet access are now widely available across all age groups.

On the other hand, online newspapers provide superior advantages that physical papers simply cannot match. First, online platforms offer a much wider range of news sources. With just a few screen touches or mouse clicks, readers can access news in multiple languages from various perspectives—something that printed newspapers, limited by physical page space and distribution boundaries, cannot achieve. Second, online news enables real-time updates. Thanks to the Internet, breaking news is reported instantly, allowing people to receive crucial information without delay, which is particularly vital during fast-developing situations such as natural disasters or global crises.

In conclusion, I strongly agree that printed newspapers are no longer needed. Although physical newspapers played an important role in the past, online news platforms have now proven to be more convenient, diverse, and timely for modern readers.
reviews.overall: Bài của em bám rất sát hướng đồng ý và phát triển đủ hai phần: thừa nhận lợi ích của báo in rồi phản biện, sau đó nêu các ưu thế nổi trội của báo trực tuyến. reviews.question:
With the rapid development of communication technology; e.g. smart phones, tablets and other mobile devices, some people believe that the disadvantages outweigh the advantages.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
It is argued that the drawbacks of advanced communication technology, such as smartphones and tablets, are more significant than its benefits. I completely disagree with this perspective because the security risks associated with these devices can be easily managed, while their advantages in global connectivity and business efficiency are far greater.   

On the one hand, security concerns are often considered a major drawback of modern communication devices. By nature, social media platforms and mobile applications make it relatively easy to fake identities, leaving users vulnerable to cyberattacks. This is demonstrated by the increasing number of reports regarding online scams using hacked social media accounts or stolen personal identification numbers. However, identity theft is not primarily caused by a lack of security on these platforms, but rather by users' carelessness. With proper care and attention, users can protect themselves from online fraud. For instance, adjusting privacy settings and turning on two-step verification can greatly reduce the incidence of identity theft.   

On the other hand, the rapid development of mobile devices brings clear advantages that improve daily life and work. Primarily, these portable technologies facilitate long-distance communication, enabling people to connect with each other regardless of their location. Individuals from all corners of the globe can now interact instantly through messaging or video calls, which was rarely the case in the past when communication was limited to local surroundings. This benefit is clearly seen in the business sector, where virtual meetings and cross-border collaboration have become common. Video conferencing allows participants from different time zones to join live discussions, which reduces travel costs and speeds up decision-making. This is particularly beneficial for startups and small businesses aiming to expand internationally.   

In conclusion, although the misuse of mobile communication devices can pose security risks, these issues can be easily resolved through user awareness. Overall, I firmly believe that the positive impacts of enhanced connectivity and efficiency far outweigh the negative points.

reviews.suggestedRevision:
It is argued that the drawbacks of advanced communication technology, such as smartphones and tablets, are more significant than its benefits. I completely disagree with this perspective because the security risks associated with these devices can be easily managed, while their advantages in global connectivity and business efficiency are far greater.

On the one hand, modern communication devices can expose users to security risks, but these risks can be substantially reduced through sensible precautions. By nature, social media platforms and mobile applications make it relatively easy to fake identities, leaving users vulnerable to cyberattacks. This is demonstrated by the increasing number of reports regarding online scams using hacked social media accounts or stolen personal identification numbers. However, identity theft has long been a problem and is not primarily caused by a lack of security on these platforms, but rather by users' carelessness. With proper care and attention, users can protect themselves from online fraud. For instance, adjusting privacy settings and turning on two-step verification can greatly reduce the incidence of identity theft.

On the other hand, the rapid development of mobile devices brings clear advantages that improve daily life and work. Primarily, these portable technologies facilitate long-distance communication, enabling people to connect with each other regardless of their location. Individuals from all corners of the globe can now interact instantly through messaging or video calls, which was rarely possible in the past when people had fewer opportunities to engage with others beyond their immediate surroundings. This benefit is clearly seen in the business sector, where virtual meetings and cross-border collaboration have become common. Video conferencing allows participants from different time zones to join live discussions, which reduces travel costs and speeds up decision-making. This is particularly beneficial for startups and small businesses aiming to expand internationally.

In conclusion, although the misuse of mobile communication devices can pose security risks, these risks can be greatly reduced through user awareness and basic security measures. Overall, I firmly believe that the positive impacts of enhanced connectivity and efficiency far outweigh the drawbacks.

reviews.question:
Some people think that the increasing use of computers and mobile phones for communication has a negative effect on young people’s reading and writing skills.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
It is argued that the growing reliance on computers and mobile phones for communication negatively impacts the reading and writing skills of the younger generation. I completely agree with this view because digital communication encourages short attention spans and normalizes informal language, both of which erode core literacy skills.   

First, the frequent use of digital devices undermines young people’s reading abilities. Content consumed on smartphones and computers is often presented in bite-sized snippets, which conditions individuals to scan information quickly rather than read deeply. As a result, many young people struggle to stay focused for extended periods, leading to comprehension problems when dealing with longer, more complex texts. To make matters worse, constant notifications pushed to their phones from social media platforms frequently interrupt their reading process. These ongoing distractions disrupt their focus and further impair their ability to fully understand written materials.   

Second, modern communication technologies significantly degrade writing skills among youth. Online interactions are increasingly dominated by informal language characterized by slang, abbreviations, and emojis. For the sake of convenience and speed, young users often fail to adhere strictly to grammar and punctuation rules. Furthermore, heavy reliance on automated features like text prediction and auto-correction on computers and smartphones prevents them from learning correct spelling, causing frequent mistakes when writing manually. Such colloquial language and grammatical inaccuracies are much less acceptable in formal contexts, such as academic essays, business proposals, and professional correspondence.   

In conclusion, I strongly agree that the widespread use of digital devices for communication impairs young people’s literacy skills. It reduces their reading comprehension through constant distractions and weakens their formal writing capabilities due to over-reliance on automated tools and informal expressions.
reviews.overall: Em trả lời đúng đề, nêu quan điểm nhất quán và triển khai đủ hai cơ chế ảnh hưởng tới việc đọc cùng hai cơ chế ảnh hưởng tới việc viết. Các chuỗi giải thích nhìn chung rõ, đặc biệt em đã dùng ‘To make matters worse’ và ‘Furthermore’ để chuyển sang ý tiếp theo. Tuy nhiên, sau câu chủ đề ở mỗi Body, em vào lý do đầu mà chưa báo rõ vai trò của ý ấy. Em thêm tín hiệu mở lý do đầu ở cả hai đoạn và diễn đạt thận trọng hơn tác động của công cụ tự sửa chính tả.

reviews.question:
The Internet has transformed the way information is shared and consumed, but it has also created problems that did not exist before.
What are the most serious problems associated with the Internet and what are the possible solutions?
reviews.originalEssay:
While the Internet has revolutionized how information is shared and consumed, it has also introduced several unprecedented issues. The most serious problems associated with this technology are cyberbullying and information manipulation, but these challenges can be effectively addressed through public awareness campaigns and stricter legislation.   

Two major problems have emerged with the proliferation of the Internet. The first issue is cyberbullying, as social media platforms are frequently used to spread lies and rumors to thousands of people in an instant. Due to the invasive nature of online harassment, victims often find it virtually impossible to escape. The second problem is information manipulation. Because there is hardly any regulation on the type of content posted online, malicious individuals can use data to their advantage. A clear example of this was seen when the Trump administration won the US presidential election, in large measure by running targeted advertisements on Facebook to influence voter behavior.   

To tackle these problems, a combination of social awareness and government action is required. First, cyberbullying can be brought to the fore through mounting awareness campaigns. Celebrities and public figures trusted by the public can help spread messages on their social media platforms, discussing the psychological distress that bullied individuals have to endure. Second, regarding online manipulation, governments should introduce legislation to check the content of social media posts and advertisements. Although determining what is illegal can be subjective and risks taking away freedom of speech, establishing clear regulatory boundaries is essential to prevent widespread public deception.   

In conclusion, cyberbullying and political manipulation represent the most alarming drawbacks of the digital age. Nevertheless, these issues can be mitigated by leveraging influential figures to raise public awareness and enacting appropriate laws to regulate online content

reviews.question:
Some people believe that reading stories from a book is better than watching TV or playing computer games for children.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
It is argued that governments should prioritize funding for practical job training over academic courses at university. Personally, I am of the opposite school of thought, since both routes need adequate investment to prepare people for the different roles required in society.   

On the one hand, university education plays a critical role in building a highly skilled workforce for key sectors of the national economy, including healthcare, education, engineering, and technology. Doctors, for example, improve public health and save lives, while engineers and technicians contribute to national productivity and innovation. Without sufficient investment in higher education, countries may face a dearth of doctors, researchers, and policymakers. Such shortages can ultimately hinder national progress, since these professionals provide knowledge and services that other members of society depend on.  

On the other hand, vocational training deserves adequate public funding, as not all young people are suited to academic study. For those with practical strengths, it offers a more realistic and rewarding alternative, enabling them to gain hands-on experience and enter the workforce earlier in construction, automotive repair, or culinary arts. Blindly encouraging all students to pursue higher education can therefore lead to wasted resources and high youth unemployment when their qualifications do not match the work they are able or willing to do. Promoting vocational education as a viable and respectable path can help reduce this mismatch and ensure that individuals enter careers suited to their strengths.   

In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that governments should support both university education and vocational training. Giving financial priority to one at the expense of the other can leave essential skills undeveloped and limit opportunities for people with different strengths.

Em mở bài về việc đọc truyện trong sách và nêu quan điểm đồng ý vì lợi ích ngôn ngữ, trí tưởng tượng; tiếp tục triển khai hai so sánh theo dàn ý Cô giao.

reviews.suggestedRevision:
It is sometimes claimed that reading stories in books benefits children more than watching television or playing computer games. I agree because stories offer richer opportunities to develop language and to exercise imagination.

Reading stories can strengthen children’s language skills more than either screen activity. As they follow fictional or real-life events in a book, children encounter varied vocabulary and ways of expressing ideas, which can enrich their language and help them absorb knowledge. Television programmes can also teach new words, expressions and grammatical structures, but their spoken language is often less diverse and complex than the language children meet in stories. Likewise, a game may ask players to read instructions about winning or completing the next mission; however, this text usually remains within the game’s setting and exposes them to fewer aspects of life than stories do.

Stories also give children more room to develop their imagination than television or games. When reading about a wondrous world, a homeless person’s suffering or a joyful moment, children have to conjure up the people and scenes for themselves, and this practice can support their creativity. In a television programme, the images are already the product of someone else’s imagination, so children mainly observe what appears on the screen. Although players may choose different strategies and tactics in a game, those choices often draw on previous experience rather than the kind of imaginative work involved in creating a story’s world in their minds.

In conclusion, I believe reading stories from books is better for children than watching television or playing computer games in these two respects. It exposes them to more varied language and encourages them to imagine events independently.

appliedKnowledge: Bài gốc có câu nêu đề và quan điểm nhưng cho câu hỏi khác; bài viết mới cần hiểu đúng đề và nêu hai lý do sẽ triển khai.
Bài gốc nối nguyên nhân–kết quả đúng nhưng sai chủ đề; bài mới vận dụng chuỗi hành động và kết quả cho ý trí tưởng tượng đúng đề.
Bài gốc có câu chủ đề nhưng thuộc đề kinh phí; bài mới đặt câu chủ đề khái quát cho thân bài ngôn ngữ rồi phát triển các so sánh được giao.
nextSteps: Em viết lại bài đúng câu hỏi về đọc truyện trong sách, tối thiểu 250 từ; không dùng lại các đoạn về kinh phí đào tạo.
Em viết một thân bài về ngôn ngữ và một thân bài về trí tưởng tượng; mỗi đoạn đối chiếu đọc truyện với TV và trò chơi theo chuỗi ý Cô giao.
Trước khi nộp, em soát mở bài, hai câu chủ đề và kết bài với nguyên văn đề để chắc chắn cùng trả lời một câu hỏi.

criteria.title: Đúng đề và bám sát dàn ý Cô giao.
evidence: It is argued that governments should prioritize funding for practical job training over academic courses at university.
criteria.comment: Cô giao đề đọc truyện so với TV và trò chơi, nhưng em viết toàn bài về kinh phí đào tạo. Đây là sai đề, nên bài chưa đáp ứng dàn ý được giao.
criteria.action: Em viết lại theo quan điểm đồng ý, hai thân bài về ngôn ngữ và trí tưởng tượng; mỗi đoạn so sánh đọc truyện với cả TV và trò chơi.

criteria.title: Giải thích ý và phản biện.
evidence: Without sufficient investment in higher education, countries may face a dearth of doctors, researchers, and policymakers.
criteria.comment: Em có giải thích khá rõ trong chủ đề đào tạo, nhưng chưa có lập luận nào về việc đọc truyện phát triển ngôn ngữ hoặc trí tưởng tượng.
criteria.action: Em triển khai hai chuỗi ý trong dàn ý đúng đề rồi đối chiếu từng ý với TV và trò chơi.

criteria.title: Vận dụng từ vựng và cấu trúc đã học.
evidence: since both routes need adequate investment to prepare people for the different roles required in society.
criteria.comment: Trong bài đã nộp, em dùng since nêu lý do và mệnh đề rút gọn “required in society” tự nhiên. Cách dùng câu đúng này đang phục vụ một đề khác.

criteria.title: Nối câu, nối đoạn và dùng từ thay thế.
evidence: Such shortages can ultimately hinder national progress, since these professionals provide knowledge and services that other members of society depend on.
criteria.comment: “Such shortages” quy chiếu rõ về tình trạng thiếu nhân lực ở câu trước; quan hệ nguyên nhân–kết quả dễ theo dõi. Em cần dùng khả năng liên kết này trong bài đúng đề.

criteria.title: Viết chính xác và tự soát bài.
evidence: In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that governments should support both university education and vocational training.
criteria.comment: Câu kết đúng ngữ pháp và khớp bài em đã viết, nhưng toàn bài không được soát lại với câu hỏi được giao. Cô không coi những câu đúng này là lỗi ngữ pháp.
criteria.action: Trước khi nộp lại, em soát mở bài, hai câu chủ đề và kết bài với nguyên văn đề đọc truyện, TV và trò chơi.
